question: _______ aims to provide permanent housing with essential services to the urban homeless in a phased manner under the Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH) scheme.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)** is a scheme launched by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India**.
 
• Under its component **Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH)**, the aim is to provide **permanent housing** with essential services to the urban homeless in a phased manner.
 
• The SUH scheme supports the construction of **night shelters** equipped with all necessary amenities such as **water supply, sanitation, and electricity**.
 
• The focus is on addressing the needs of the **urban homeless population**, especially those living in conditions of extreme poverty or destitution.
 
• The mission also emphasizes convergence with other schemes like the **Swachh Bharat Mission** for sanitation and **Skill India** for livelihood generation.
 
• NULM aims to create a sustainable model that reduces urban poverty by enhancing livelihood opportunities and providing **shelter and basic infrastructure**.
 
• The implementation of SUH involves collaboration between **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)** and other stakeholders to ensure inclusivity and efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rural Housing Scheme**__

 __
 
• The **Rural Housing Scheme** is focused on providing housing solutions for the **rural poor** rather than the urban homeless.
 
• It includes programs like **Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana (PMGAY)**, which targets rural areas for affordable housing construction.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Awas Yojana**__
 __
 
• Rajiv Awas Yojana was launched with the goal of achieving a **slum-free India** by providing basic facilities in slum areas and enabling housing upgrades.
 
• This scheme targeted urban slum dwellers but did not specifically focus on the **urban homeless population**.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister Housing Scheme**__
 
 
• The **Prime Minister Housing Scheme** refers to **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**, which encompasses housing for all by 2022 but is not specifically centered around the urban homeless.
 
• It addresses the needs of both urban and rural populations for affordable housing solutions.
